svg.text: RSI at every rung, 1% to 100% — each one's full history
Each row is one instrument, each cell one rung (1% of its days). Red = RSI under 50, green = over 50; the stronger the colour, the further from 50. Deepest bottom rung at the top.
rung (percentile of that instrument's own days) → ▯ outlined cell = where the latest close sits
